# Limits and rules
The server enforces these limits. The numbers below are the defaults; the host can change them. The Session tab's status line shows your session's live grid, entity and area limits.
## Your map
[bold]Map area[/bold] 256 by 256 tiles, centred on the map's origin. A border marks it. [bold]Grids[/bold] 6 per member, 8 per session at most. [bold]Entities[/bold] 25000 across all your session's levels, 30 on one tile. [bold]Decals[/bold] 16 on one tile. [bold]Z-levels[/bold] 3 per session. [bold]Members[/bold] 8 per session.
## One edit
[bold]Area[/bold] 4096 tiles for a selection, shape, fill or erase. [bold]Entities[/bold] 2000, contents included, for a copy, paste, delete, erase or undo. [bold]Decals[/bold] 4096 for a copy or paste. [bold]Speed[/bold] 60 placements, tiles, erases and decals a second. Past that they're dropped. [bold]Undo[/bold] 30 steps per mapper.
## Your library
50 maps, 256 MiB in all, 25 versions per map. Uploads and reference files up to 1.5 MiB. Templates up to 16 MiB, 8 MiB to share.
## When you hit one
You get a popup at the cursor, and the Mapping window or lobby shows a line naming the limit. A placement past a limit is reverted. A paste, reference or upload that would go past one is refused whole.
## Things you can't place
Anything that reaches past your own map is refused at placement and paste, and stripped from references, uploads and opened maps with a count:
- Singularities, tesla balls, event horizons and gravity wells. - Ghost roles and ghost role spawners. - Game rules and station events. - Things that announce themselves to the server when they spawn. - Radios that hear every channel. - Things players can warp to and follow, such as the nuke, the disk and Nar'Sie.
Hidden and abstract prototypes are refused too. Entities need a grid; lay floor first.
Mobs can be placed but don't save. Use their spawners. See Placing things.
## Problems
If something breaks, or someone is wrecking your map, press [bold]AHelp[/bold] on the menu bar.
